title: #19 Birth Rate
prompt: In many countries, the birth rates are lowering, and the problems of an ageing population are serious. What are the causes and the effects of this phenomenon? what should we do to address these issues?

promptSegments.text: In many countries, the birth rates are lowering, and the problems of an ageing population are serious.
What are the causes and the effects of this phenomenon?
what should we do to address these issues?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: to deal with or mention something

requirements.en: Identify the main problems or causes.
requirements.vi: Xác định các vấn đề hoặc nguyên nhân chính.
Đề xuất các giải pháp thực tế.

requirements.en: Explain why the solutions could work.
requirements.vi: Giải thích vì sao các giải pháp có thể hiệu quả.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main cause of low birth rates is the difficulty of raising children in modern life, which is shown by the focus on careers and high living costs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main cause of low birth rates is the difficulty of raising children in modern life, which is shown by the focus on careers and high living costs.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Government policies and immigration are effective solutions because they provide financial support and help maintain a strong population structure.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Government policies and immigration are effective solutions because they provide financial support and help maintain a strong population structure.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Government policies and immigration are necessary solutions to declining birth rates and aging populations.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Government policies and immigration are necessary solutions to declining birth rates and aging populations.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The first body paragraph identifies the problem (declining birth rates straining social services), and the second body paragraph proposes solutions (policies and immigration).
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph identifies the problem (declining birth rates straining social services), and the second body paragraph proposes solutions (policies and immigration).

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary challenge is the declining fertility rates, which undermine the sustainability of current social structures.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary challenge is the declining fertility rates, which undermine the sustainability of current social structures.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Implementing targeted government policies alongside managed immigration streams offers a viable path to mitigate demographic decline.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Implementing targeted government policies alongside managed immigration streams offers a viable path to mitigate demographic decline.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not list abstract solutions without directly linking each solution to a specific root cause mentioned.
promptTraps.vi: Không liệt kê giải pháp chung chung mà không gắn kết trực tiếp với từng nguyên nhân cụ thể đã nêu.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh dùng các câu văn mẫu học thuộc lòng chung chung và các ý lạc đề.
